scripts.push:website: sh -c 'cd website && git add . && git commit -m "${npm_config_message:-update website}" || test "$?" = 1; git push -u origin main'
scripts.push:app: sh -c 'cd app && git add . && git commit -m "${npm_config_message:-update app}" || test "$?" = 1; git push -u origin main'
scripts.push:all: pnpm run push:website && pnpm run push:app
